settings.eyebrow: Velocitas Cycling Club · Est. 2012 · USA Cycling club
settings.headline: The pack that never drops you.
settings.copy: Velocitas is more than a club — it's a training collective. Group rides every weekend, coached programs for every level, and a race team that's stood on podiums from state crits to gravel nationals. No matter where you start, you'll finish faster here.

trust_list.text: Rides at every level — social to race team
Structured coaching by certified USA Cycling coaches

settings.title: Built to
settings.intro: Twelve seasons of riding, racing, and building riders up from their first century to their first podium.

stats.label: Weekly group rides, all year round
Podiums at regional and national events

settings.title: Find your
settings.intro: Three tracks into Velocitas, each with its own rides, coaching, and community. Join one, or roll through them all as you build.

design.title: Sunday Social
design.text: A no-drop 30–45 mile spin every Sunday morning. Coffee stop halfway, all paces welcome, nobody left behind.

design.title: Gravel Grinder
design.text: Monthly off-road adventure — mixed-surface routes, farm roads, and trails for riders who like their miles a little loose.

build.title: Tuesday Interval Lab
build.text: A coached VO2 and threshold session on the club's rolling circuit. Structured, measured, and surprisingly fun.

build.title: Century Training Block
build.text: A 12-week progressive plan to your first (or fastest) century — long rides, nutrition coaching, and a finish-line crew.

launch.title: Elite Development Squad
launch.text: For racers aiming at podiums. Periodized training plans, race support, and a tight group of committed teammates.

launch.title: Race Support Crew
launch.text: Mechanics, feed zones, and team cars at every race — so our athletes can focus on the effort, not the logistics.

settings.title: From first ride
settings.intro: Joining Velocitas takes about an hour of your week and changes how you ride for good. Here's the path in.

steps.title: Join a Sunday Social
steps.text: Ride with us once before you commit. Every pace is welcome — we'll pair you with a group that fits your fitness.

steps.title: Meet the club
steps.text: Grab coffee after the ride, meet the ride leaders, and find the track that matches your goals. Ask anything.

steps.title: Membership & insurance
steps.text: Sign up, get covered under our USA Cycling club insurance, and pick the track — social, development, or race.

steps.title: Gear up & go
steps.text: You're in. Weekly rides, structured programs, and a clubhouse of riders who'll push you and pick you up in equal measure.

settings.note: First ride is always free. If you're not a member yet, the Sunday Social is the easiest yes in cycling.

settings.title: More than
settings.intro: There are plenty of ways to ride alone. We exist to make you faster, safer, and more consistent than you'd ever be on your own.

features.title: Certified coaching
features.text: Every training program is designed by USA Cycling-certified coaches. No guesswork — just measured, periodized progress.

features.title: Rides for every level
features.text: From the Sunday social to the elite squad, there's a pack that matches your pace. Ride up through them as you build.

features.title: Real race support
features.text: Team cars, mechanics, feed zones, and a support crew at every race. You show up to suffer; we handle the rest.

features.title: Community that shows up
features.text: Flat tire on a Tuesday night? Someone is driving out with a tube. That's the culture we protect.

features.title: Safety first
features.text: Ride leaders, route vetting, club insurance, and clear group-riding etiquette on every outing.

features.title: Year-round calendar
features.text: Winter trainer rides, spring build camps, summer racing, and fall classics. The calendar never sleeps.

settings.intro: A snapshot of a Velocitas season — coffee stops, finish lines, gravel days, and the miles between.

settings.title: What riders
settings.intro: We asked a few members what Velocitas means to them. The answers read like a mission statement.

reviews.quote: I came for the Sunday social and stayed for the race team. Three seasons later I've got a state championship, a training plan I actually trust, and friends I'd drive two hours to help with a flat.
reviews.author: Mateo R.

reviews.quote: As someone who barely rode before joining, the development program took me from 'fear the century' to a 100-mile finish with a grin. The no-drop policy is real — someone always waits.
reviews.author: Priya K.

reviews.quote: I've raced on a lot of teams. Velocitas is the first where the support crew out-hustles the athletes. New bike, tubeless sealant, feed bottles — they think of everything so you just ride.
reviews.author: Jonas W.

settings.title: Come ride
settings.intro: Questions about joining, a ride time, or bringing a group ride through town? Drop us a note — a ride leader replies within a day.
settings.location: Velocitas Cycling Club · 14 Peloton Plaza, Riverside, OR

settings.blurb: A competitive road and gravel cycling club — structured training, group rides, and race support for riders who want to go further, faster, together.
